single_authority: story_stage and journey.stage derive Q001..Q005 states; do not also persist Q001..Q005 delivered/boss/gate booleans. Generic quest service reads this explicit adapter. Other quests remain separately keyed, never named Q001..Q005 duplicate.

import_new_fields.sect.legacy_opening_spend: old earned-old available-sum old promotion costs up to actual rank

journey_projection.before_enabled: journey must equal exact original default; Q004/Q005 unavailable, no received rewards

cross_field_validation: before story completed, journey must stagevalley_hunt/kills[0,0]/repeat[0,0]
valley boss/report or later require valley kills>=5; valley_hunt requires valley kills<5
north boss/report or completed require north kills>=5; north_hunt requires north kills<5; north precount allowed while valley stages
repeat claims[i]*5 <= journey kills[i]; valley repeat requires at least north_hunt stage; north repeat requires completed
sect rank>0 requires story completed and level>=promotion level3/5/8; rank>1 requires at least north_hunt; rank>2 requires journey completed
nondefault sect requires story at leastgathering; earned equals available+promotion prefix+legacy_opening_spend+new_exchange_spend for normal history, explicit configuration ledger separate
sect commissions[i]*3 <= adventure corresponding lifetime counter; one-time claimed flags require3/3/6 counter thresholds
source-style sword_owned stage requires actual mapped story sword; task history does not generate missing instances
death/pending loot receipt projection never creates quest state ahead of stage; old return/completed stage imports no unpicked loot entitlement
persistent_reward_receipt_rule: new runtime task step event receipts are separate idempotency identities, not alternative stage booleans; on import no synthetic XP/items are replayed to manufacture absent historical logs
configuration_policy: explicitly configured story/sect exception must satisfy structural types and carry declared scoped exception; no ordinary source import gets automatic exception to fix contradictions
not_covered: whole profile schema, all14class fields/effects/activities/inventory instances and new127source task definitions; component coverage never certifies full save import
normal_history_validation: 普通历史与四已知旧导入先运行normal_history完整根+十四项阶段/门派前置/一次委托阈值分支；重复轮数乘5、贡献守恒/等级、真实任务收据及源物品仍按原cross_field_validation完整验证。配置例外只在原显式来源与作用域证明后进入对应原规则，不用普通历史失败自动切例外。

normal_numeric_validation.integer_gate: 先验全部非负安全整数且严格JSON整数token，bool/小数/指数不能靠数学等值通过。正常字段范围及十四项结构前置先验，不对坏值取整或截断。
normal_numeric_validation.repeat_hunts: 对i=0/1检查repeat_claimed[i] <= kills[i]整除5；实际领取前检查当前claimed小于kills整除5，下一轮claimed+1可表示，再按原owner一次领取。不要先乘5或给(余额+1)制造溢出。
normal_numeric_validation.sect_commissions: 三项sect.commissions_claimed各 <= 对应adventure计数整除3；对应关系精确野猪/霜狼/竹材，不能借另一计数或主线journey计数凑数。一次委托bool用原3/3/6阈值，与门派重复3计数分开。
normal_numeric_validation.contribution_balance: 晋级实际前缀费用沿原10/25/50，rank0/1/2/3为0/10/35/85。先核earned>=各扣项并从remaining=earned依次减晋级前缀、legacy_opening_spend、new_exchange_spend、available，每次扣项大于remaining即拒绝，末余须0；等价精确守恒，避免多个合法MAX加总溢出。不按差额给玩家补贡献。
normal_numeric_validation.external_preconditions: rank对应等级至少3/5/8须读取同一完整角色progress推导等级，不能在此子根存level镜像。完整正常历史须具真实任务/捐献/委托/兑换或受支持旧导入来源；数值守恒不单独证明已获授权，配置例外沿原显式作用域另验。

normal_character_projection.extraction: 完整角色根先验，再从同角色progress及quests.retained_story_adventure提取两字段，不存包装/level镜像。normal_history阶段与字段约束同时运行。
normal_character_projection.maintenance: 三经验阈值由唯一等级经验records编译；配置生成/规则包构建须核schema门槛与源表相等，变表必须同步重编，不能在运行时硬编码另一曲线。等级数仅说明，不进入持久角色。
normal_character_projection.boundaries: 正常历史等级不足拒绝，不按等级赠门派晋级，也不清rank修档。显式配置降级/改门派仅按原配置来源及作用域处理，不能因本投影失败自动切例外；贡献账与任务来源仍须另验。
